sources.title: Entry into the Maldives is prohibited on Israeli passports
sources.officialityEvidence: The live immigration.gov.mv page identifies Maldives Immigration as the official passport and visa-services authority and publishes the entry restriction.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Entry into the Maldives on Israeli passports is prohibited effective from 15th April 2025.

unresolved.reason: Maldives Immigration expressly prohibits entry on Israeli passports from 2025-04-15. The model has no entry-prohibition status, so this cannot honestly be normalized as visa_on_arrival or visa_required.
